scope: Union of compiler-generated dependency files for four parent/native-host builds and pinned old build, complete old source, exact old DLL and native-host DLLs, corpus preprocessing dependencies, compiler and known native host/backend sources. Core Garnet source, checkpoint assets, caller cases and SDK/runtime IDs also have separate manifests. Not a claim to hash every OS dyld-cache page.
